name: Ling-3.0-tiny

lineage.how_derived: hybrid reasoning MoE; a UBTree tree-speculative-decoding draft (Ling-3.0-tiny-UBTree, 0.37 GB, DFlash backbone with a learned bigram selector, MIT) exists for SGLang

purpose: Strong reasoning and agentic capability at low inference cost for local and resource-constrained deployment (card).

license.name: MIT (card tag)
license.notes: Card tag mit; no LICENSE file in the repo, text not read.

architecture.kind: hybrid linear-attention MoE (3 Kimi Delta Attention : 1 MLA per 4-layer block)

variants.notes: FP8 and INT4 weights also provided
Q8_0 8.41 GB; 12.7k downloads; a community GGUF has 242k
